"""Host-only credential lifecycle for askeve_github_read.

Per tool call: vend the existing ``user/ask-eve-bot`` App key from the token broker (the same HTTP
protocol as the token-broker client's ``POST /request``), sign an App JWT, mint ONE installation
token limited to softmax-universe/ask-eve with exactly {metadata, contents, issues, pull_requests}:
read, verify GitHub's mint readback and the token's own repository listing, hand the caller a
GET-only function bound to that repository, then revoke the token (DELETE /installation/token)
and verify the revoked token is refused (401).

Secrets (broker client token, App private key, App JWT, installation token) live only in local
variables of this module's functions. They never go to os.environ, argv, files, logs, return
values or exception text: every error raised here carries a fixed, plugin-authored message and
is raised ``from None``.

The lifecycle calls (broker POST /request, GitHub POST /app/installations/<id>/access_tokens,
GET /installation/repositories, DELETE /installation/token) are fixed host-authored management
calls; nothing here is model-selectable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import http.client
import json
import re
import ssl
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

# ---- fixed bindings (private constants; never taken from the model, env or config) ----------
OWNER, NAME = "softmax-universe", "ask-eve"
REPO = f"{OWNER}/{NAME}"
REPO_ID = 1437622364
APP_ID = "5518203"
INSTALLATION_ID = "176351662"
PERMISSIONS = {"metadata": "read", "contents": "read", "issues": "read", "pull_requests": "read"}
GITHUB_HOST = "api.github.com"
BROKER_HOST = "cdsrezebj75evx33ppyorn43ia0ayckl.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws"
BROKER_SCOPE = "user/ask-eve-bot"
APP_ENV = ("ASK_EVE_BOT_APP_ID", "ASK_EVE_BOT_INSTALLATION_ID", "ASK_EVE_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY")
BROKER_DIR = Path("/home/ubuntu/.config/token-broker")
REPO_PREFIX = f"/repos/{OWNER}/{NAME}"

WIRE_CAP = 1024 * 1024          # max response body read from any host
MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME = 3600       # GitHub installation tokens live exactly 1h: expires_at <= now + 3600 s
REVOKE_RESERVE = 5.0            # seconds of the call deadline kept for revoke + verification
REVOKE_FLOOR = 1.0              # revocation is always attempted, even when the deadline is spent
USER_AGENT = "askeve-github-read"
API_VERSION = "2022-11-28"


class ReadError(Exception):
    """A plugin-authored failure. ``kind`` is machine-readable, ``str()`` is a fixed message."""

    def __init__(self, kind: str, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.kind = kind


def _default_connection(host, port, *, timeout, context):
    # http.client never consults *_PROXY env vars and never follows redirects.
    return http.client.HTTPSConnection(host, port, timeout=timeout, context=context)


def _remaining(deadline, clock):
    left = deadline - clock()
    if left <= 0:
        raise ReadError("timeout", "call deadline exceeded")
    return left


def https(factory, host, method, path, headers, body, deadline, clock=time.monotonic):
    """One HTTPS exchange with a fixed host. Returns (status, {lowercase header: value}, bytes).

    3xx is a transport refusal (never followed). Bodies over WIRE_CAP refuse. Every socket read
    is bounded by what is left of ``deadline``. Any socket/TLS/HTTP failure becomes a fixed-text
    ReadError with no chained exception text."""
    try:
        conn = factory(host, 443, timeout=_remaining(deadline, clock), context=ssl.create_default_context())
    except ReadError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("transport", "could not open HTTPS connection") from None
    try:
        conn.request(method, path, body=body, headers=headers)
        resp = conn.getresponse()
        status = int(resp.status)
        if 300 <= status < 400:
            raise ReadError("transport", "redirect refused")
        chunks, total = [], 0
        while True:
            left = _remaining(deadline, clock)
            sock = getattr(conn, "sock", None)
            if sock is not None:
                sock.settimeout(left)
            chunk = resp.read(64 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            total += len(chunk)
            if total > WIRE_CAP:
                raise ReadError("oversize", "response body exceeds 1 MiB")
            chunks.append(chunk)
        hdrs = {str(k).lower(): str(v) for k, v in (resp.getheaders() or [])}
        return status, hdrs, b"".join(chunks)
    except ReadError:
        raise
    except TimeoutError:
        raise ReadError("timeout", "network timeout") from None
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("transport", "HTTPS transport failure") from None
    finally:
        try:
            conn.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


def _json(data):
    try:
        return json.loads(data) if data else None
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return None


def _github_headers(auth):
    return {"Authorization": auth, "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            "User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "X-GitHub-Api-Version": API_VERSION}


def check_dependencies():
    """Fail closed when the host lacks PyJWT or cryptography (RS256 App JWTs)."""
    import importlib
    try:
        for module in ("jwt", "cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization",
                       "cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.rsa"):
            if importlib.import_module(module) is None:
                raise ImportError(module)
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("credential", "host dependency PyJWT/cryptography is missing") from None


def validate_private_key(pem):
    """Accept an unencrypted RSA (>=2048 bit) key in PKCS#1 or PKCS#8 PEM; else refuse."""
    try:
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("credential", "host dependency cryptography is missing") from None
    if not isinstance(pem, str):
        raise ReadError("credential", "App private key malformed")
    head = pem.lstrip()
    if not (head.startswith("-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----") or head.startswith("-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----")):
        raise ReadError("credential", "App private key is not PKCS#1/PKCS#8 PEM")
    try:
        key = serialization.load_pem_private_key(pem.encode(), password=None)
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("credential", "App private key unreadable") from None
    if not isinstance(key, rsa.RSAPrivateKey) or key.key_size < 2048:
        raise ReadError("credential", "App private key is not an RSA key of at least 2048 bits")


def default_signer(app_id, pem):
    try:
        import jwt  # PyJWT, with cryptography for RS256
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("credential", "host dependency PyJWT is missing") from None
    now = int(time.time())
    try:
        return jwt.encode({"iat": now - 60, "exp": now + 540, "iss": str(app_id)}, pem, algorithm="RS256")
    except Exception:
        raise ReadError("credential", "App JWT signing failed") from None


def _parse_expiry(value):
    try:
        return datetime.strptime(str(value), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ReadError("credential", "minted token expiry unreadable") from None


def _repos_exact(repos):
    if not isinstance(repos, list) or len(repos) != 1 or not isinstance(repos[0], dict):
        return False
    return repos[0].get("id") == REPO_ID and repos[0].get("full_name") == REPO


class Credentials:
    """``with creds.session(deadline) as get:`` yields ``get(path, query='') -> (status, headers, body)``.

    ``get`` is GET-only, bound to api.github.com and to paths under /repos/softmax-universe/ask-eve.
    The session's non-secret status record (mint, verify, revoke, post_revoke, revocation) goes
    into the caller's ``lifecycle`` dict, completed by the revoke in ``finally``; concurrent
    sessions never share it."""

    def __init__(self, *, broker_dir=BROKER_DIR, connection=None, signer=None, clock=time.monotonic,
                 wall=time.time):
        self.broker_dir = Path(broker_dir)
        self.connection = connection or _default_connection
        self.signer = signer or default_signer
        self.clock, self.wall = clock, wall

    # -- broker ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _vend(self, reason, deadline):
        try:
            broker_token = (self.broker_dir / "token").read_text().strip()
            session_id = (self.broker_dir / "session-id").read_text().strip()
        except OSError:
            raise ReadError("credential", "host token-broker client is not configured") from None
        if not broker_token or not session_id:
            raise ReadError("credential", "host token-broker client is not configured")
        body = json.dumps({"scope": BROKER_SCOPE, "reason": reason, "session_id": session_id,
                           "resources": []})
        status, _h, data = https(self.connection, BROKER_HOST, "POST", "/request",
                                 {"Authorization": "Bearer " + broker_token,
                                  "Content-Type": "application/json"}, body, deadline, self.clock)
        del broker_token
        if status != 200:
            raise ReadError("credential", f"broker refused {BROKER_SCOPE} (HTTP {status})")
        resp = _json(data)
        del data
        if not isinstance(resp, dict):
            raise ReadError("credential", "broker response malformed")
        state = resp.get("status")
        if state == "pending":
            raise ReadError("credential", "broker grant for the Ask Eve App is pending owner approval")
        if state in ("denied", "canceled", "expired"):
            raise ReadError("credential", "broker grant for the Ask Eve App was " + state)
        env = resp.pop("env", None)
        del resp
        if not isinstance(env, dict) or set(env) != set(APP_ENV) \
                or not all(isinstance(env[k], str) and env[k] for k in APP_ENV):
            raise ReadError("credential", "broker vended an unexpected Ask Eve App credential shape")
        if env[APP_ENV[0]].strip() != APP_ID or env[APP_ENV[1]].strip() != INSTALLATION_ID:
            raise ReadError("credential", "broker vended a different App or installation")
        return env[APP_ENV[2]]

    # -- GitHub lifecycle ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _mint(self, pem, deadline, final_deadline, lc):
        validate_private_key(pem)
        app_jwt = self.signer(APP_ID, pem)
        del pem
        if not isinstance(app_jwt, str) or not app_jwt:
            raise ReadError("credential", "App JWT signing failed")
        status, _h, data = https(self.connection, GITHUB_HOST, "POST",
                                 f"/app/installations/{INSTALLATION_ID}/access_tokens",
                                 {**_github_headers("Bearer " + app_jwt), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                 json.dumps({"repositories": [NAME], "permissions": dict(PERMISSIONS)}),
                                 deadline, self.clock)
        del app_jwt
        lc["mint"] = status
        body = _json(data)
        del data
        token = body.pop("token", None) if isinstance(body, dict) else None
        if status != 201 or not isinstance(token, str) or not token.startswith("ghs_"):
            if isinstance(token, str) and token:
                self._revoke(token, final_deadline, lc)  # something was minted: kill it
            raise ReadError("credential", f"installation token mint failed (HTTP {status})")
        return token, body

    def _check_mint(self, body):
        if body.get("permissions") != PERMISSIONS:
            raise ReadError("credential", "minted token permissions are not exactly the read set")
        if body.get("repository_selection") != "selected" or not _repos_exact(body.get("repositories")):
            raise ReadError("credential", "minted token repositories are not exactly " + REPO)
        exp = _parse_expiry(body.get("expires_at"))
        now = self.wall()
        if not now < exp <= now + MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME:
            raise ReadError("credential", "minted token expiry outside the 1-hour window")

    def _get(self, token, path, deadline):
        return https(self.connection, GITHUB_HOST, "GET", path, _github_headers("token " + token), None,
                     deadline, self.clock)

    def _verify_listing(self, token, deadline, lc):
        status, _h, data = self._get(token, "/installation/repositories", deadline)
        lc["verify"] = status
        body = _json(data)
        if status != 200 or not isinstance(body, dict) or body.get("total_count") != 1 \
                or not _repos_exact(body.get("repositories")):
            raise ReadError("credential", "installation token can see more or other than " + REPO)

    def _revoke(self, token, final_deadline, lc):
        try:
            status, _h, _b = https(self.connection, GITHUB_HOST, "DELETE", "/installation/token",
                                   _github_headers("token " + token), None,
                                   max(final_deadline, self.clock() + REVOKE_FLOOR), self.clock)
            lc["revoke"] = status
            st2, _h, _b = self._get(token, "/installation/repositories",
                                    max(final_deadline, self.clock() + REVOKE_FLOOR))
            lc["post_revoke"] = st2
        except ReadError as exc:
            lc.setdefault("revoke", "error:" + exc.kind)
        except Exception:
            lc.setdefault("revoke", "error")
        lc["revocation"] = "verified" if lc.get("revoke") == 204 and lc.get("post_revoke") == 401 else "uncertain"

    @contextmanager
    def session(self, deadline, reason="Ask Eve read-only GitHub tool call", lifecycle=None):
        lc = {} if lifecycle is None else lifecycle
        work_deadline = deadline - REVOKE_RESERVE
        check_dependencies()
        pem = self._vend(reason, work_deadline)
        token, body = self._mint(pem, work_deadline, deadline, lc)
        del pem
        try:
            self._check_mint(body)
            del body
            self._verify_listing(token, work_deadline, lc)

            def get(path, query=""):
                if not isinstance(path, str) or not (path == REPO_PREFIX or path.startswith(REPO_PREFIX + "/")):
                    raise ReadError("refused", "data-plane path outside " + REPO)
                if re.search(r"[\s?#\\]", path) or not isinstance(query, str) \
                        or (query and not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_=&.%-]*", query)):
                    raise ReadError("refused", "data-plane path or query malformed")
                return self._get(token, path + ("?" + query if query else ""), work_deadline)

            yield get
        finally:
            self._revoke(token, deadline, lc)
            del token
